    StartersRey's instant breadQuick soda bread with a deep cross on top, torn apart warmHow to make it450g plain flour1 tsp bicarb soda1 tsp salt400ml buttermilk50g butter, to serve2 tbsp honeyMix the flour, bicarb and salt. Stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough.Shape into a round, cut a deep cross on top and bake at 200°C until risen and hollow sounding.Tear warm and serve with butter and honey.Niima Outpost datesMedjool dates filled with goat cheese and walnut, with honey, apricots and figsHow to make it16 medjool dates150g goat's cheese16 walnut halves2 tbsp honey100g dried apricots100g dried figsSlit the dates and remove the stones.Fill each with a little goat's cheese and press a walnut half on top.Drizzle with honey and arrange on a board with the dried apricots and figs.BB-8 saffron aranciniBB-8 rolling across the sandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Saffron risotto balls with a melting mozzarella centre, crumbed and fried deep orange, with a smoky paprika aioli for the white stripe.Soak a pinch of saffron in 750ml hot stock.Soften an onion in butter, add 250g arborio and stir in the stock a ladle at a time for 18 minutes.Stir in 40g parmesan and spread out to cool.Shape 16 balls around a cube of mozzarella.Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko and fry at 180°C for 4 minutes.Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, a crushed garlic clove and smoked paprika to dip.Crispy pork belly bitesA thousand years, and Maz still feeds everyone.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMaz Kanata's slow-roast lamb feastGarlic rosemary lamb shoulder roasted 5 hours, flatbreads, garlic yoghurtHow to make it2kg lamb shoulder4 garlic cloves, crushed1 tbsp chopped rosemary1 tbsp smoked paprika3 tbsp olive oil2 tsp salt4 flatbreads300g Greek yoghurt1 garlic clove, crushed, for the yoghurt600g mixed vegetables for roasting (pumpkin, zucchini, red onion)Rub the lamb with the garlic, rosemary, paprika, oil and salt.Roast covered at 150°C for 5 hours until it pulls apart easily.Roast the vegetables alongside for the last 40 minutes. Stir the garlic into the yoghurt and warm the flatbreads to serve with the lamb.Starkiller Base barramundi parcelsHan and Ben on the Starkiller walkwayHow to make itAs written, serves 4Barramundi baked in paper parcels with lemon, dill, capers and butter, torn open at the table, with crushed potatoes and a sharp fennel slaw.Lay 4 barramundi fillets on squares of baking paper.Top each with lemon slices, dill, 1 tsp capers and 15g butter, season and fold into sealed parcels.Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.Boil 800g baby potatoes, crush with olive oil and salt.Shave a fennel bulb thin and toss with lemon juice, olive oil and dill.Open the parcels at the table.SweetsAhch-To island sconesLight cream and lemonade scones served warm with strawberry jamHow to make it450g self-raising flour300ml thickened cream, for the dough300ml lemonade4 tbsp strawberry jam300ml thickened cream, whipped, to serveMix the flour, cream and lemonade until just combined.Pat out on a floured bench, cut into rounds and bake close together at 220°C until risen and golden.Serve warm with strawberry jam and whipped cream.DrinksMillennium Falcon spiced mochaCoffee with hot cocoa milk, brown sugar and cinnamonHow to make it250ml very strong coffee, or 4 espresso shots700ml milk3 tbsp cocoa, plus extra to dust2 tbsp brown sugar1/2 tsp ground cinnamon150ml thickened cream, whippedBrew the coffee.Warm the milk with the cocoa, sugar and cinnamon, whisking until frothy, without boiling.Divide the coffee between four metal mugs and pour in the hot chocolate milk. Top with whipped cream and dust with cocoa.Spiced dark rum on iceChewie, we're home. Pour two.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
